name: Trail Shell Jacket
description: A three-layer waterproof shell with a helmet-compatible hood and pit zips. Cut for layering: size up if you plan to wear a heavy fleece underneath.

name: Merino Crew Sweater
description: Midweight 100% merino knit that regulates temperature and resists odor. Runs true to size with a relaxed body and slightly long sleeves.

name: Everyday Tee
description: Heavyweight organic cotton with a ribbed collar that keeps its shape. Pre-shrunk, so buy your usual size.

name: Canvas Work Pant
description: Twelve-ounce duck canvas with a gusseted crotch and reinforced knees. Straight leg with a 32-inch inseam; waist sizes are measured in inches.

name: Fleece Half-Zip
description: Recycled grid fleece with a tall collar and a zippered chest pocket. Fits close through the body; most people take their tee size.

name: Daypack 20L
description: A 20-liter pack with a padded laptop sleeve, stretch side pockets, and a sternum strap. Fits torsos from 16 to 20 inches.

name: Roll-Top Tote
description: Waxed canvas tote that rolls down for groceries and opens up for a weekend. Holds about 25 liters when fully extended.

name: Travel Duffel 45L
description: Carry-on sized duffel with stowable backpack straps and a separate shoe compartment. Meets most airline cabin limits at 22 by 14 by 9 inches.

name: Sling Bag
description: A four-liter crossbody sling with a key leash and a hidden back pocket. Strap adjusts from 28 to 52 inches.

name: Insulated Bottle 750ml
description: Double-wall stainless steel that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. Fits standard cup holders and comes with a leakproof cap.

name: Wool Beanie
description: Ribbed merino beanie with a fold-over cuff. One size stretches to fit most heads comfortably.

name: Leather Belt
description: Full-grain leather belt with a solid brass buckle, 1.5 inches wide. Order the size two inches above your pant waist.

name: Trail Socks, 3-Pack
description: Merino-blend crew socks with cushioned soles and a seamless toe. Sized by US shoe size.

name: Polarized Sunglasses
description: Lightweight acetate frames with polarized lenses and spring hinges. Medium fit; comes with a hard case and a microfiber cloth.

name: Enamel Mug Set
description: Two 12-ounce steel mugs with a chip-resistant enamel finish. Campfire safe; not for microwaves.

name: Camp Blanket
description: Recycled wool blanket, 50 by 70 inches, with a water-resistant nylon backing. Packs into its own carry strap.

name: Cedar Candle
description: Soy wax candle with cedar and smoke notes in a reusable glass jar. Burns for about 45 hours.

name: Field Notebook, 3-Pack
description: Three pocket notebooks with dot-grid pages and a water-resistant cover. 48 pages each, 3.5 by 5.5 inches.

name: Cast Iron Skillet, 10 inch
description: Pre-seasoned cast iron with a helper handle and two pour spouts. Works on induction, gas, oven, and open flame.

name: Linen Apron
description: Stonewashed linen apron with cross-back straps and two front pockets. One size; straps adjust for most heights.
